title: Oven Roasted Australian Tofu Casserole
description: A nutty and velvety Australian dish featuring garlic sauce, this Jain-friendly casserole is perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the garlic sauce and olive oil.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the garlic sauce mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cooked brown rice and frozen mixed vegetables.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the rice and vegetable mixture.
Add a layer of the tofu on top of the rice mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of rice on top.
Sprinkle the chopped nuts over the top of the casserole.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
